name: CNSIG Inner Mongolia Chemical Industry Co.,Ltd.
summary: CNSIG Inner Mongolia Chemical Industry Co.,Ltd. engages in the business of salt chemicals. It operates through its Salt Production, Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Import and Export Trade, Wastewater Treatment, and Other segments. The company offers silicate cement, polyvinyl chloride resin, paste resin and ammonium chloride, soda ash, ion exchange membrane base, washing and regenerating salt, caustic soda, PVC, metallic sodium, sodium chlorate, trichloroisocyanuric acid, cement and clinker, and other products. The company was formerly known as Inner Mongolia Lantai Industrial Co., Ltd. CNSIG Inner Mongolia Chemical Industry Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is based in Alxa Zuoqi, China.
